summary: Eishun Fushimi is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. They studied at the University of Hamburg (attested 1998) under David P. Jackson.

Eiun Hino is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a master's course at the University of Tokyo (~2004–2006). He held posts at the University of Tokyo (~2011–2015) and Musashino University (~2015).

Ekai Kawaguchi (1866–1945) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying under teachers including Hiroshi Tsuchiya, Hozan Saeki, Kozen Shaku, Unsho Shaku, and Sarat Chandra Das. He held posts at Toyo University (1916), Taisho University (~1926–1931), and Toyo Bunko (1940).
Eki Nakayama works in Buddhist studies. Nakayama studied at Kyoto University and held a post at the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science as a DC2 fellow, both attested in 2020.
Ekkyo Uno is a scholar in Buddhist studies. Uno served as a lecturer at Osaka University of Foreign Studies (attested 1991) and as a commissioned researcher at Honganji-ha Shogakuin (attested 1998).

Eleanor Rosch works in philosophy and Buddhist studies. She studied at Reed College (~1955–1959) and Harvard University (~1964–1969), and took up a post at the University of California, Berkeley around 1971.
Elena De Rossi Filibeck is a scholar of Tibetology. She held positions at Sapienza University of Rome (attested 1997) and the University of Bonn.
Elena France Hanson works in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She earned her PhD at Harvard University, where she studied under Charles Hallisey (attested 1998).
Elena Mucciarelli is an Indologist who studied at the University of Tübingen (~2008–2012). She held posts at the University of Tübingen (~2013, 2016–2017) and the University of Groningen (2020).

Eli Franco works in Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. He held posts at Kyoto University, the Austrian Academy of Sciences (~1993–2005), La Trobe University (attested 1997), the University of Vienna, and Leipzig University (attested 2007–2022).

Elijah Ary works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Sera Monastery, INALCO (~1995–2000), and Harvard University (~2000–2007) under Janet Gyatso, Leonard van der Kuijp, Charles Hallisey, and Geshe Karma Sonam.

Eliot Deutsch (1931–2020) was a philosopher and Indologist who studied at Columbia University (~1957–1960). He edited Philosophy East and West (~1967–1988) and held posts at Harvard, Chicago, Cambridge, and the University of Hawaii (attested 2009).

Elisa Freschi works in Indology and philosophy. She studied under Raffaele Torella (~2002–2006) and held posts at the Austrian Academy of Sciences (2012), Sapienza University of Rome (attested 2012), the Institute for the Cultural and Intellectual History of Asia, and the University of Vienna (both attested 2022).

Elisabeth Schüssler Fiorenza works in religious studies. She studied at the University of Würzburg (~1958–1963) and the University of Münster (~1965–1970), later holding posts at the University of Notre Dame (~1970–1985) and Harvard University (~1988).

Elizabeth Ann Cecil specializes in Indology, religious studies, and history/archaeology. She studied at Hastings College, the University of Tennessee, and Brown University, holding posts at the University of Groningen (2011–2013), Leiden University (~2016–2017), and Florida State University (~2017).

Elizabeth English specializes in Buddhist studies and Indology. She completed her PhD at the University of Oxford by 1999, studying under doctoral supervisor Alexis Sanderson and teacher Harunaga Isaacson.

Elizabeth Errington works in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She studied at SOAS University of London under Adrian David Hugh Bivar (~1981–1987) and served as a curator at the British Museum (attested 2003).

Elizabeth Guthrie is a scholar in religious studies and Buddhist studies. She completed her PhD at the University of Canterbury by 1994 and served as a tutor in religious studies at the University of Otago (~2004).

Elizabeth J. Harris works in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She earned her doctorate at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies and University of Kelaniya (~1988–1993) under Ananda W. P. Guruge and Y. Karunadasa, later holding a post at the University of Birmingham (~2017).

Elizabeth Mills is an Indologist who completed her D.Phil. at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson by 2011. She held a post teaching Sanskrit and Pali at the University of Toronto (attested 2020).
